IS 2325 : 1981 Ignition coils for battery-coil ignition systems for automobilesUDC 621.43.044.3 : 629.113.066TED 11Reaffirmed 20211 Scope1.1 This standard covers the basic mechanical and electricalrequirements and methods of test for 6, 12 and 24 V ignition coilsalong with the mounting dimensions for use with automobiles withbattery as source (with or without a ballast resistance in theprimary circuit).1.2 This standard does not cover ignition coils of the vibrationtype.1.3 This standard does not cover energy transfer ignition coilsand magneto-ignition systems used on two wheelers and threewheelers.2 ReferenceIS 8395 : Part I :1977Specification for cable terminations for automobile wiring:Part I Blade type connectors
